import click

def test_deprecated_command_help():
    @click.command(deprecated=True)
    def cli():
        pass

    ctx = click.Context(cli)
    formatter = ctx.make_formatter()
    cli.format_help_text(ctx, formatter)
    output = formatter.getvalue()
    print(repr(output))
    assert output == "  (DEPRECATED)\n" or output == "(DEPRECATED)\n", repr(output)

    @click.command(deprecated=True)
    def cli():
        pass

    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"])
    print(repr(result.output))

    # "  (DEPRECATED)\n" is a substring of "   (DEPRECATED)\n"!
    assert "\n  (DEPRECATED)\n" in result.output
